data.one_liner: Shows platform‑adaptive alert dialogs and action sheets
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to display alert dialogs, confirmation dialogs, text input dialogs, and modal action sheets that adapt to iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web. The dialogs automatically use Cupertino or Material styles based on the platform.
use_when: Need a text input dialog that blocks destructive actions
Need a modal action sheet for iOS‑style options
Need cross‑platform dialog support without custom styling
avoid_when: You need highly custom dialog designs
You are targeting older Flutter versions (<3.47)
You require advanced theming beyond the default
weaknesses: Limited customization beyond the provided options
No support for custom dialog widgets
